# kmem-trace

```text
usage: kmem-trace [-h] [-s] [-b] [-v] [-c COMMAND] [--all]

```

Tracing kernel memory (SLUB and buddy) allocations and frees.
    Unless --all is specified, only the (de)allocations triggered by the current frame will be printed.
### Optional arguments

|Short|Long|Help|
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
|-h|--help|show this help message and exit|
|-s|--trace-slab|enable slab (de)allocation tracing|
|-b|--trace-buddy|enable buddy (de)allocation tracing|
|-v|--verbose|print backtraces|
|-c|--command|command to be traced (e.g. `n`, `nextret`) (default: 'n')|
||--all|display ALL memory allocations/frees regardless if they are triggered by the current frame.|
